marta.cs: Quick check-in — weekly account pulse for OnboardCorp. Error rate up 1.8% week-over-week. Digging into breakdown: 5xx = 58% of errors, timeouts = 27%, rate-limits = 15%. Top failing callsites below.

sam.ops: yikes. any idea which endpoints are spiking?

alejandro.eng: attaching the top 10 from our query. primary culprits are: /v1/chat/stream, /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings/bulk, /internal/cache/kv, /v1/rerank.

jess.product: are these user-triggered bursts or background jobs? OnboardCorp mentioned nightly batch ingestion last week.

marta.cs: timeline matches their batch window (01:00-02:30 UTC). The 5xx rate peaks during that window.

sam.ops: error types in 5xx mostly 502/503 with occasional 504s. Timeouts are predominantly from the gateway -> runtime (connect/read). Rate-limits are client-key throttles (short bursts).

ryan-sre: can you paste the sample logs? need stack traces for 503s.

alejandro.eng: pasted snippet:
```
2026-03-15T01:12:42Z ERROR handler.go:243 request_id=abc123 upstream=runtime-73 status=503 message="kv cache OOM, dropped connection"
2026-03-15T01:13:05Z WARN proxy.go:78 request_id=def456 backend_connect_timeout
```

marta.cs: link to full query + chart: https://dash.redwood.example/onboardcorp/err-weekly?range=7d

jess.product: flagged as renewal risk note — if this persists we should offer a config tweak or rate-limited onboarding window.

sam.ops: short-term mitigations: 1) throttle their batch ingestion at proxy 2) enable prefix caching for common prompts 3) add retry-with-backoff on their side. Happy to draft the proxy rule.

alejandro.eng: medium-term: increase KV cache memory for the dedicated pool serving OnboardCorp and add circuit-breaker for cache OOMs. Also patch runtime to surface clearer 503 reasons.

ryan-sre: I'll schedule a canary on the dedicated pool tomorrow 02:00 UTC and watch for regressions.

cs-bot: Reminder: weekly-account-health-checkin report for OnboardCorp generated. PDF: /reports/onboardcorp-weekly-2487654321.pdf

marta.cs: action items: @sam.ops draft proxy throttle rule (due EOD), @alejandro.eng look into KV mem bump + runtime 503 reasons (due tomorrow), @jess.product prepare renewal note w/ remediation offer (due Wed). I'll follow up in next check-in. :+1:

sam.ops: on it — drafting now.

alejandro.eng: starting investigation, will post findings in this thread.

jess.product: will draft a conciliatory note plus optional onboarding window changes.

marta.cs: thanks everyone — keeping this on the top of the queue since it touches SLA/renewal. If anyone needs the raw traces ping me and I'll grant access.
